mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, driving positive 5-day S&P 500 returns as market liquidity improves.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS < 4.5% periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 200.0) signals potential central bank tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 200.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust economic expansion, accelerating corporate earnings growth and driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: The joint increase in GDPC1 and HOUST does not produce positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a decline in unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions, accelerating economic activity and driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0 and declining, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong consumer spending (RSAFS > 370000) indicates robust retail activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS > 370000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals strong manufacturing output, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in INDPRO increasing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) indicates weakening manufacturing activity, reducing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In an early-cycle expansion regime (HOUST > 1500), rising housing starts signal strong consumer confidence and economic growth, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1500, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
